task:
Implement the ring buffer in `ring/ring.go`. The functions currently panic.

`New(capacity int) (*Ring, error)` returns an error when capacity <= 0.
`Push(v int) (evicted int, wasEvicted bool)` appends v as the newest item;
when the buffer is already full it drops the oldest item and returns it
with true, otherwise returns 0 and false. `Len() int` is the number of
stored items. `Items() []int` returns a new slice, oldest to newest;
mutating it must not affect the buffer. Use no packages outside the
standard library.
